arxiv-1808-02943.title: Coaxioms: flexible coinductive definitions by inference systems
arxiv-1808-02943.creator: Francesco Dagnino
arxiv-1808-02943.description: Abstract . We introduce a generalized notion of inference system to support more flexible interpretations of recursive definitions. Besides axioms and inference rules with the usual meaning, we allow also coaxioms , which are, intuitively, axioms which can only be applied “at infinite depth” in a proof tree.

arxiv-2106-09180.title: RHNAS: Realizable Hardware and Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2106-09180.creator: Yash Akhauri*, Adithya Niranjan*, J. Pablo Muñoz, Suvadeep Banerjee, Abhijit Davare, Pasquale Cocchini, Anton A. Sorokin, Ravi Iyer, Nilesh Jain
arxiv-2106-09180.description: Abstract The rapidly evolving field of Artificial Intelligence necessitates automated approaches to co-design neural network architecture and neural accelerators to maximize system efficiency and address productivity challenges. To enable joint optimization of this vast space, there has been growing interest in differentiable NN-HW co-design.

arxiv-2109-12716.title: Disordered Monomer-Dimer model on Cylinder graphs
arxiv-2109-12716.creator: Partha S. Dey ⋆, Kesav Krishnan †
arxiv-2109-12716.description: Abstract . We consider the disordered monomer-dimer model on cylinder graphs 𝒢 n \mathcal{G}_{n} , i.e. , graphs given by the Cartesian product of the line graph on n n vertices, and a deterministic graph. The edges carry i.i.d. random weights, and the vertices also carry i.i.d. random weights, not necessarily from the same distribution.

arxiv-2210-06169.title: MODEL ORDER REDUCTION OF SOLIDIFICATION PROBLEMSECCOMAS CONGRESS 2022
arxiv-2210-06169.creator: Florian Arbes 1,2, Øyvind Jensen 1, Kent-Andre Mardal 2 and Jørgen S. Dokken 3
arxiv-2210-06169.description: Abstract Advection driven problems are known to be difficult to model with a reduced basis because of a slow decay of the Kolmogorov N N -width. This paper investigates how this challenge transfers to the context of solidification problems and tries to answer when and to what extend reduced order models (ROMs) work for solidification problems.

arxiv-2302-12142.title: 142 GHz Multipath Propagation Measurements and Path Loss Channel Modeling in Factory Buildings This research is supported by the NYU WIRELESS Industrial Affiliates Program and National Science Foundation (NSF) Research Grants: 1909206 and 2037845.
arxiv-2302-12142.creator: Shihao Ju and Theodore S. Rappaport
arxiv-2302-12142.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shihao Ju and Theodore S. Rappaport. This paper presents sub-Terahertz (THz) radio propagation measurements at 142 GHz conducted in four factories with various layouts and facilities to explore sub-THz wireless channels for smart factories in 6G and beyond. Here we study spatial and temporal channel responses at 82 transmitter-receiver (TX-RX) locations across four factories in the New York City area and over distances from 5 m to 85 m in both line-of-sight (LOS) and non-LOS (NLOS) environments.

arxiv-2302-13134.title: Correlation between phase stiffness and condensation energy across the non-Fermi to Fermi-liquid crossover in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model on a lattice
arxiv-2302-13134.creator: D. Valentinis, G. A. Inkof, J. Schmalian
arxiv-2302-13134.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by D. Valentinis, G. A. Inkof, J. Schmalian. We construct and analyze a lattice generalization of the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, where spinful fermions experience on-site, random, all-to-all interactions with an Einstein bosonic mode, and random intersite coherent hopping. We obtain the exact self-consistent numerical solution of the model at mean-field level, and analytical approximations, for all values of fermion-boson coupling and hopping, under the spin-singlet ansatz and at particle-hole symmetry, both in the normal and superconducting states, thus tracing the entire phase diagram.

arxiv-2407-07818.title: The Misclassification Likelihood Matrix: Some Classes Are More Likely To Be Misclassified Than Others
arxiv-2407-07818.creator: D. Sikar, A. d’Avila Garcez, R. Bloomfield, T. Weyde, K. Peeroo, N. Singh, M. Hutchinson, D. Laksono, M. Reljan-Delaney Department of Computer Science, City St George’s, University of London
arxiv-2407-07818.description: Abstract This study introduces the Misclassification Likelihood Matrix (MLM) as a novel tool for quantifying the reliability of neural network predictions under distribution shifts. The MLM is obtained by leveraging softmax outputs and clustering techniques to measure the distances between the predictions of a trained neural network and class centroids.

arxiv-2408-08805.title: CIKMar: A Dual-Encoder Approach to Prompt-Based Reranking in Educational Dialogue Systems
arxiv-2408-08805.creator: Joanito Agili Lopo, Marina Indah Prasasti, Alma Permatasari
arxiv-2408-08805.description: Abstract In this study, we introduce CIKMar 1 1 1 https://github.com/joanitolopo/cikmar-system , an efficient approach to educational dialogue systems powered by the Gemma Language model. By leveraging a Dual-Encoder ranking system that incorporates both BERT and SBERT model, we have designed CIKMar to deliver highly relevant and accurate responses, even with the constraints of a smaller language model size.

arxiv-2602-16020.title: MolCrystalFlow: Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction via Flow Matching
arxiv-2602-16020.creator: Cheng Zeng, Harry W. Sullivan, Thomas Egg, Maya M. Martirossyan, Philipp Höllmer, Jirui Jin, Adrian Roitberg, Richard G. Hennig, Stefano Martiniani, Ellad B. Tadmor, Mingjie Liu
arxiv-2602-16020.description: Abstract Molecular crystal structure prediction represents a grand challenge in computational chemistry due to large sizes of constituent molecules and complex intra- and intermolecular interactions. While generative modeling has revolutionized structure discovery for molecules, inorganic solids, and metal–organic frameworks, extending such approaches to fully periodic molecular crystals is still elusive.

pmc-12595411.title: Serum response factor is essential for endometrial function and prevention of inflammatory fibrosis
pmc-12595411.creator: Ryan M. Marquardt, Sara A. Grimm, San-Pin Wu, Peter F. Lais, Shu-Yun Li, Xin Xu, Erin Smithberger, David Cunefare, Charan Ganta, David Olson, Eunhee M. Jeong, Jae-Wook Jeong, Bruce A. Lessey, John P. Lydon, Francesco J. DeMayo
pmc-12595411.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SignificanceSeveral infertility-associated gynecological diseases share the pathophysiological features of excessive inflammation and fibrosis, but the mechanisms underlying these processes remain elusive. Our study utilizes clinical human endometrial tissues, cultured human endometrial stromal cells, and single-cell analysis of genetically engineered mouse uterine tissues to define the endometrial function of serum response factor (SRF), a transcription factor seldom studied in the context of reproduction.

pmc-12733835.title: Eastern Arc of Glacial Relict Species—Population Genetics of Violet Copper Lycaena helle Butterfly in East-Central Europe
pmc-12733835.creator: Cristian Sitar, Marcin Sielezniew, Adam Malkiewicz, Zdenek Faltynek Fric, Martin Konvička, Hana Konvickova, Joji M Otaki
pmc-12733835.description: Simple SummaryThe Violet Copper (Lycaena helle) is distributed at high latitudes and among the mountains of Eurasia. It is protected in the EU, considered a glacial relic, and threatened by habitat loss and climate change. It has been studied mainly in Western Europe, where genetic studies revealed differentiation of population systems due to mutual isolation.

pmc-13340249.description: BackgroundPaenibacillus species are rod-shaped, gram-variable, endospore-forming, environmental bacteria. uslaw-usc-t20-s959a.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 26 (Support And Scholarship In Humanities And Arts; Museum Services); Subchapter I (National Foundation On The Arts And The Humanities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The National Endowment for the Arts and the National Endowment for the Humanities are on and after August 2, 2005, authorized to solicit, accept, receive, and invest in the name.
